definitions.purpose: Seller-side evidence, transfer and acquisition-documentation readiness. This is not buyer due diligence and does not replace buyer-specific legal, technical, security or financial review.

evidenceMaturity.E3: Tests, validation and provenance/release evidence identified.
evidenceMaturity.E4: E3 plus repository-retained independent/external validation evidence identified.

ipRightsMaturity.R2: R1 plus dependency/third-party disclosure basis identified.
ipRightsMaturity.R3: R2 plus SBOM/lockfile and provenance/rights-supporting evidence identified.
ipRightsMaturity.R4: R3 plus independent legal chain-of-title opinion or equivalent external legal evidence.

commercialMaturity.C0: No separate standalone seller-side economic reference.
commercialMaturity.C2: Seller ask and reproducible economic reference established.
commercialMaturity.C3: C2 plus attributable transaction/comparable or income evidence.
commercialMaturity.C4: C3 plus independent professional valuation evidence.

transferReadiness.T1: Implementation exists but core transfer evidence is incomplete.
transferReadiness.T2: Source, documentation, tests and licence evidence support bounded handover.
transferReadiness.T3: T2 plus validation, build/release and dependency-disclosure evidence.
transferReadiness.T4: T3 plus a content-reviewed, release-specific component/licence record, security and provenance evidence, an explicit deliverable handover package, and no unresolved seller-side delivery blockers. File names or package-generation code alone do not qualify.

transactionReadiness.READY: T4 with a content-reviewed, release-specific handover package, reconciled component/licence obligations and no unresolved seller-side delivery blockers. Buyer-specific acceptance remains separate.
transactionReadiness.READY_WITH_CONDITIONS: T2 or T3: a bounded source/evidence handover basis exists, but the listed delivery or qualification conditions are unresolved.
transactionReadiness.NOT_READY: T0 or T1: no implemented baseline, or essential source/test/licence/transfer evidence is incomplete.
